notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Bitter Glass
notes.content:
Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro is finally available on Steam!
After months of work, the second episode of the Scary Shadow Spot series is ready to take you on a journey into psychological horror, filled with eerie puzzles and hidden truths.
[hr][/hr]
A Cursed Saloon and the Mystery of John Doe
This time, you’ll be thrown into the heart of the Wild West, in a forgotten saloon lost in the desert. Here, time has stopped, and the ghosts of a dark past are waiting… for you.
Who is John Doe? What really happened at Bicchiere Amaro? Only by exploring the saloon and solving its puzzles will you uncover the truth.
[hr][/hr]
A Psychological Horror Inspired by The Twilight Zone
Like the first episode, Bicchiere Amaro draws inspiration from the legendary series The Twilight Zone, delivering a story shrouded in mystery, with plot twists that will make you question everything you think you know.
[hr][/hr]
What to Expect
✔️ A chilling and surreal atmosphere.
✔️ Puzzles that will test your logic.
✔️ A cast of… dead characters.
✔️ A story that will pull you in until the final revelation.
[hr][/hr]
Add the Game to Your Wishlist!
If you enjoyed Ultimo Addio, you’ll love Bicchiere Amaro too. And if you haven’t played the first episode yet, now is the perfect time to catch up!

💀 Scary Shadow Spot - Bicchiere Amaro is available NOW on Steam!
📌 Add it to your library and let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: DEMO: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before
notes.content:
LOST ALONE ULTIMATE is coming!

Get ready to dive back in as George Tellaselv.
Whether you are entering this adventure for the first time or have already played the Lost Alone trilogy: you are about to discover a new world of terror.

Lost Alone Ultimate is not a remake of the Lost Alone trilogy, but a re-made!

To let you savor the new world that awaits you, the demo is now available: Lost Alone Ultimate - The Day Before.

You will experience the day leading up to the events of Lost Alone Ultimate, savoring a light appetizer of the terror that awaits you.

Lost Alone Ultmate - The Day Before is a self-contained demo that offers content that won't be present in the final game.

So: Enjoy a little secret sneak peek into George's life.

notes.title: Who Knocks
notes.content:
I am pleased to announce the arrival of:
WHO KNOCKS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40960555/74ae13e9d66342253293c2433ff89f972ec259a0.gif


Who Knocks is a first person psychological horror game that will make your nightmares come true. You have just moved into a new house and are about to experience the longest night of your life. Welcome the presences that will knock on your door. Solve puzzles, explore the environment and fight your nightmares.
